cases.translation: The Lord said to Abram, 'Leave your country.'
cases.explain: The verb сказал (said) takes an indirect object in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Иди в ___, которую я тебе укажу.
cases.translation: Go to the land that I will show you.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Аврааму было семьдесят пять лет, когда он ушёл из ___.
cases.translation: Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of/from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он поставил шатёр между Вифилем на западе и ___ на востоке.
cases.translation: He pitched his tent between Bethel on the west and Ai on the east.
cases.explain: The preposition между (between) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: На земле был голод, и Авраам направился жить в ___.
cases.translation: There was a famine in the land, and Abram went to live in Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative case (inanimate = nominative form).

cases.sentence: Когда они подходили к Египту, он сказал ___ Саре.
cases.translation: As they were approaching Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai.
cases.explain: The verb сказал (said) takes an indirect object in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Когда её увидели придворные ___, они расхвалили её.
cases.translation: When the princes of Pharaoh saw her, they praised her.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession ('the princes of Pharaoh').

cases.sentence: Господь поразил фараона и весь его дом тяжёлыми ___.
cases.translation: The Lord struck Pharaoh and all his house with grievous diseases.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means or instrument ('with diseases').

reading.ru: Аврааму было семьдесят пять лет, когда он ушел из Харана.
reading.question: How old was Abram when he left Haran?
reading.explain: The text says Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

reading.ru: И Авраам отправился в путь, как сказал ему Бог, и Лот пошел вместе с ним.
reading.question: Who went with Abram on his journey?
reading.explain: The text says Lot went together with Abram.

reading.ru: На земле был голод, и Авраам направился жить в Египет, потому что голод был очень силен.
reading.question: Why did Abram go down to Egypt?
options: Because there was a severe famine in the land
Because God commanded him to build there
reading.correct: Because there was a severe famine in the land
reading.explain: The text says there was a famine in the land, so Abram went to live in Egypt.

reading.ru: Там он построил жертвенник Господу и призвал имя Господа.
reading.question: What did Abram do at that place?
options: He built an altar to the Lord and called on the Lord's name
reading.correct: He built an altar to the Lord and called on the Lord's name
reading.explain: The text says he built an altar to the Lord there and called on the name of the Lord.

reading.ru: Но Господь поразил фараона и весь его дом тяжелыми болезнями из-за Авраамовой жены Сары.
reading.question: Why did the Lord afflict Pharaoh and his house?
reading.explain: The text says the Lord struck Pharaoh and his house because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

reading.ru: Они отправились в землю Ханаана и пришли туда.
reading.question: Where did Abram and his household travel to?
reading.explain: The text says they set out for the land of Canaan and came there.
